verdict.rationale: Docs confirm skills are just plain-text folders with a SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter + Markdown), optionally bundling scripts/references/assets, following the open agentskills.io standard that 'works across multiple AI tools,' making them inherently copyable and portable rather than a proprietary binary. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of someone literally copying a skill folder into a different, non-Anthropic harness and confirming it worked unmodified.
